headline_seed: Lake Powell Hits Lowest Level On Record As Water Crisis Continues - The New York Times
draft_text:
Lake Powell hit a record low of 3,519.91 feet Saturday, per ABC News — breaking its own 2023 record.

Combined with Lake Mead's recent low, storage is at its lowest since 1957. Forty million people across seven states depend on this water.

And that's the mews.
